name: docgov
description: Documentation governance for agentic development: taxonomy, authority graph, drift detection, and deterministic gates that run on every write.

enforcement.title: Enforcement level
enforcement.description: Override the project mode's enforcement. 'repo' uses .docgov/config.yaml (recommended), 'warn' never blocks a write, 'strict' blocks every deterministic violation.

semantic_gate.title: Semantic gate on new documents
semantic_gate.description: Run a fast model check on newly written documents for audience-lens and visibility problems. Adds roughly two seconds to creating a document; does nothing on edits.

session_briefing.title: Session briefing
session_briefing.description: Inject the authoritative-document list at session start so agents know what they may not contradict.
